requirement_text:
Organisation: Apollo Hospitals
Segment: Healthcare — Patient Engagement

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: Python, Dialogflow, Node.js, MongoDB
KNOWLEDGE BASE SOURCES: Clinical guidelines, Internal Confluence documentation, Patient FAQs, Medical literature
SUPPORTED LANGUAGES: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu
PERSONA AND TONE: Empathetic, informative, professional, and culturally sensitive
FALLBACK MECHANISMS: Escalation to a human clinician for complex cases, Emergency service dial-out for critical symptoms
EXPECTED OUTCOME: Achieve a 40% reduction in call center volume within six months, Maintain a patient satisfaction score above 4.2 out of 5
REGULATORY CONSTRAINTS: No diagnostic claims allowed, Immediate emergency routing for life-threatening symptoms, Comprehensive clinical audit logging required
USER ACCESS POINTS: Accessible through the Apollo mobile app and website, ensuring multi-channel availability
